title: Drives

panels.title: SSD wear: rated endurance used

targets.expr: max by (nodename, device, model) (nvme_percentage_used_ratio * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{job="proxmox-hosts"}) * 100

panels.description: The drive's own estimate of how much of its rated write endurance is used (NVMe 'percentage used'). Past 100% the maker no longer vouches for it.

panels.title: Written in the last 24h, per host (local SSDs)

targets.expr: sum by (nodename) ((increase(node_disk_written_bytes_total{job="proxmox-hosts"}[24h]) * on(instance, device) group_left(model) node_disk_info{job="proxmox-hosts", path!~"ip-.*", device=~"nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|sd[a-z]+"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{job="proxmox-hosts"})

panels.description: Bytes written to each host's own SSDs over the last day: physical NVMe and SATA drives only, not ZFS volumes, LVM volumes or the NAS's iSCSI LUNs (which would count the same writes twice).

targets.expr: (rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{job="proxmox-hosts"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance, device) group_left(model) node_disk_info{job="proxmox-hosts", path!~"ip-.*", device=~"nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|sd[a-z]+"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{job="proxmox-hosts"}

panels.title: Written in the last 24h, per SSD

targets.expr: (increase(node_disk_written_bytes_total{job="proxmox-hosts"}[24h]) * on(instance, device) group_left(model) node_disk_info{job="proxmox-hosts", path!~"ip-.*", device=~"nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|sd[a-z]+"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{job="proxmox-hosts"}

panels.title: Top guests by writes, last 24h

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (name, node) (increase(pve_disk_written_bytes_total[24h]) * on(id) group_left(name, node) pve_guest_info))

panels.description: Each guest's disk writes as Proxmox counts them (its virtual disks), wherever they land.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (name) (rate(pve_disk_written_bytes_total[$__rate_interval]) * on(id) group_left(name) pve_guest_info))

panels.title: NAS block storage writes (iSCSI LUNs)

targets.expr: (rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{job="proxmox-hosts"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance, device) group_left(model) node_disk_info{job="proxmox-hosts", path=~"ip-.*iscsi.*"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{job="proxmox-hosts"}

panels.description: Writes to each host's LUN on the NAS (nas-block: Prometheus and Alertmanager). These miss the hosts' SSDs.

targets.expr: min by (nodename, device) (nvme_available_spare_ratio * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{job="proxmox-hosts"}) * 100
max by (nodename, device) (nvme_temperature_celsius * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{job="proxmox-hosts"})

panels.title: NVMe media errors and critical warnings

targets.expr: max by (nodename, device) (nvme_media_errors_total * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{job="proxmox-hosts"})
max by (nodename, device) (nvme_critical_warning * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{job="proxmox-hosts"})

panels.description: Any value above 0 is worth a look.

description: SSD wear and writes on the Proxmox hosts, per drive and per guest. Written in git (kubernetes/prod/system/monitoring/dashboards/).
